name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention and accurately reflects behaviour: renders the candidate party-roster grid (up to 3 visible chars) with an item-stat preview (current vs would-be-equipped stats, side by side). No Ghidra address residue. Matches decompilation and sole-caller context.
purpose: Render the class-filtered party-roster grid (up to 3 visible chars) with an item-equip stat preview, showing each char's current AP/DP/DX/Evade stats side by side with the stats they would have if they equipped the candidate item, color-coded by comparison.
logic_summary: blink_frame = (subframe_anim_counter == 3) ? 1 : counter. draw_count = min((int)candidate_count, 3). For iter = 0..draw_count-1: char_idx = *(byte*)(scroll_offset + iter + candidate_array_ptr). Compute preview[4] = fd2_compute_equipped_stats_with_item_preview(char_idx, item_id). Read current AP/DP/DX/Evade from runtime_char[char_idx]. row_y = iter*0x1A + 0x75. Blit 24x24 portrait (blink variant indexed by char_idx*0x30 + blink_frame*4) at row_y*0x140 + surface_offset + 0xE. border_glyph = (scroll_offset+iter == highlight_idx) ? 0xC9 : 0xCD. Render char name via fd2_display_dialog_scene (FDTXT page = char_id+1). Then four stat pairs (AP/DP/DX/Stat4): for each, color = fd2_pick_stat_compare_color(current, preview), blit a current-stat unit icon (atlas[+0x4E/+0x52/+0x56/+0x5A]) and the preview arrow icon (atlas[+0x5E]), and render both the current and preview values as 3-wide decimals sharing that color. AP/DX use row bases (row_y+3)/(row_y+4); DP/Stat4 use (row_y+0xC)/(row_y+0xD). Does not display the item name (that text id is computed/stashed by the caller chain).
signature: void __cdecl fd2_render_party_roster_with_item_stat_preview(uint candidate_count, uint candidate_array_ptr, uint item_id, int highlight_idx, int surface_offset)

params.name: candidate_count
params.semantics: Number of equip-capable chars in the candidate list; loop count, capped to 3 visible rows via min((int)candidate_count, 3).
params.reason: Descriptive, matches usage as the row-loop bound (capped to 3). No address residue.

params.name: candidate_array_ptr
params.semantics: Base of the candidate char-id byte array; row i char = *(byte*)(candidate_array_ptr + scroll_offset + i).
params.reason: Descriptive, matches usage as the candidate char-id array base. No address residue.

params.name: item_id
params.semantics: Candidate item id; forwarded verbatim to fd2_compute_equipped_stats_with_item_preview to derive the preview stats.
params.reason: Descriptive and matches the shop item id forwarded to the preview compute helper. No address residue.

params.name: highlight_idx
params.semantics: Selected row index; the row whose (scroll_offset+iter) equals it gets the 0xC9 highlight border glyph (others 0xCD).
params.reason: Descriptive, matches use as the selection-highlight comparison index. No address residue.

params.name: surface_offset
params.semantics: Destination surface base address: either the composed-target workspace buffer (initial draw) or 0xA0000 VGA framebuffer (re-draws); all blit/text destinations are computed relative to it.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches the per-call destination base (workspace_c or 0xA0000). No address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; pure rendering side effect into the destination surface.

notes: Source comment (rndmenu.c lines 444-488) is already precise and matches the decompilation and the sole caller (fd2_party_roster_class_select_loop @ 0x2E8CF), which passes highlight_idx = data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx and surface_offset = workspace_c (initial) or 0xA0000 (redraw). Ghidra plate is consistent with the refined understanding (no change). The 4th stat is 'Stat4' in the source comment / 'stat4_current' field (types.h: +0x4E physical evasion / dodge %), matching the decompiler's wEvade; conservative naming, not a logic issue. No name/comment/plate changes were required; only the shard was added.
